scientific_target: Reduce candidate area and matched-random success while preserving complete recovery of the 19 Campanula microdonta development clusters.
generator_leakage_rule: 2026 field coordinates and outcomes are never generator inputs; they are read only after a candidate universe has been frozen for each experiment.

layers.source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) numerical elevation models
layers.resolution: 1 m / 5 m / 10 m depending on coverage

layers.source: ESA WorldCover annual Sentinel-2 NDVI composite
JAXA EORC High-Resolution Land Use and Land Cover Map of Japan
USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature

required: complete 19/19 development recovery at the declared radius, or explicit proof that the data layer creates a lower ceiling
lower candidate-grid fraction or lower route/search budget than the current best
promotion_rule.negative_results: Retain failed layers and harmful feature combinations as ablations; do not add variables merely because they are available.
